description: Modelled from Zurich Airport's own published 'Operating Concepts' (North/East/South), the closest real-world analogue to YSSY's mode system found in research (docs/LSZH_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md). No AIP-stated per-mode crosswind or tailwind limit was found, so every mode falls back to the pack's default limits (settings.json), same as NFFN's approach, pending confirmation. No capacity limit has been set for any mode. ATIS wording is the project's shared generic default, NOT a confirmed LSZH transcript (none was found) — correct if a real one turns up.

modes.description: North concept (standard): arrivals 14 and 16, departures 28 and 16
North concept, north-easterly wind variant: arrivals 14, departures 10
East concept (standard): arrivals 28, departures 32 and 34. Also matches the airport's published strong-westerly override (takeoff 32 / land 28).
South concept (standard): arrivals 34, departures 32 and 34. The published occasional use of 28 for departures in this concept is not modelled (no threshold found).
South/evening concept, north-easterly wind variant: arrivals 34, departures 10

atisWording.source: project default, not a confirmed LSZH transcript (none found), 29-10-2026
